title: Longest Increasing Subsequence (LIS)
intuition: Find the longest subsequence where values are strictly sorted. Transitions match elements against all preceding items.
step_by_step_strategy: State: dp[i] is LIS length ending at index i.
Transition: dp[i] = max(dp[j] + 1) for all j < i if nums[j] < nums[i].
complexity: Time: O(n^2) or O(n log n) with patience sorting
content: Find the longest subsequence where values are strictly sorted. Transitions match elements against all preceding items.
